currentFindings.finding: Current contract explicitly calls CUI development status/GUI packaging and redirected diagnostic policy a remaining gate. Autostart restores existing deployment without settings/unlock. No requirement mandates an activating failure popup at logon.

All modes use one main; run errors only eprintln + failure exit. No windows_subsystem attribute. [] starts application(false), --autostart starts application(true), --repair starts recovery UI; all existing probes share this bin.
Win7 target-wide flags force CONSOLE6.01 during tests/product/clippy. Single source windows_subsystem attribute cannot independently establish final GUI PE/version while this override remains.
Current header helper checks PE32 and Win7 version but not actual GUI/CUI role; Copy-Executable has the trusted role and should pass it into header validation.
Currently requires CUI3 for every audited EXE; product GUI must be requested explicitly by caller without accepting GUI test EXEs silently.
Calls audit_pe without role, so will reject GUI product until updated. New package metadata must truthfully describe GUI product and diagnostic redirected IO.
pe_header checks x86/version6.1 but lacks subsystem2 requirement; its parse_objdump call also needs explicit product GUI role. Existing MSI lifecycle limitations remain.
No tracked current file with this path/name was found. Existing CI header helper and any later independent artifact checker need role-aware rules; do not invent an audit of a missing file.

minimalPatch: main.rs single normal bin: cfg_attr(all(windows,not(test)),windows_subsystem="windows"). Preserve console test harness. Rust linker GUI attribute also selects mainCRTStartup; do not replace it solely with an outer linker flag.

Keep target-wide Win7 CONSOLE6.01 for test compilation and clippy. Only product-compile changes build to cargo rustc with explicit -p fc-bootstrap --bin fc-bootstrap and final -- -C link-arg=/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS,6.01. Get-BaselineCargoArguments accepts rustc and applies the same required -Z build-std on Win7. Modern product rustc can use the same command with no Win7 tail override. Exactly one product build/normal metadata collection.

Cargo documents trailing rustc arguments only affect selected final target, not dependencies. This is an implementable candidate, not an asserted universal duplicate-link-option precedence guarantee. Hard-check final product GUI2 and all test harnesses CUI3; Win7 both version6.1. Actual MSVC linker/output evidence is decisive.

No implicit AttachConsole/AllocConsole/FreeConsole or inherited handle replacement. Preserve valid inherited file/pipe stdout/stderr. No console means std output can silently disappear; redirected diagnostics must retain process ownership, real exit wait/code and original byte streams.

main classifies exact [] and unique --repair as manually invoked GUI error-feedback modes before run; call safe bounded fc_windows adapter only on their errors. All probes/unknown args/autostart keep nonzero exit and stderr, no dialog. Autostart does not activate a new popup/settings/auth screen; it retains existing application state/manager reconciliation behavior.

Update audit-pe API to explicit expected subsystem/role with strict defaults for old CUI evidence, not accept either2/3 indiscriminately. Parent product packaging calls must require GUI. Test/artifact roles come from Cargo JSON, not path substring guesses.
Update package declarations/README and plan22 current-status increment after actual results. Retain old ZIP/MSI/CI/report bytes and their original CUI contracts; do not rewrite them as GUI.
validationNeeded: Pure argument helper regressions: Modern vs Win7 tests/rustc/clippy, explicit target enforcement, -Z build-std exactly once, GUI tail only final product and unchanged test flags; CI remains hosted-only and no EXE execution.

Role-aware synthetic PE bytes: GUI product2 accepted, CUI product3 rejected, test CUI3 accepted/GUI test2 rejected; malformed/truncated headers and wrong Win7 version rejected. Test exact field extraction, not output-string substitution.

Actual modern/Win7 MSVC all22 PE table: normalGUI2, testsCUI3, Win7 version6.1, staticCRT and previous import gates. GNU independent audit same roles. A subsystem header alone does not certify any OS runtime.

Owned no-interaction Windows process tests with inherited pipes/files: --version/--self-check and representative hidden probe original stdout/stderr/footer and actual exit; unknown arg failure must be nonzero and no dialog. Child-process reopen helpers remain captured. No file redirection override or shell returning before child actually exits.

Normal GUI no-console/error-feedback behavior needs owned hidden/control or separately authorized visible test. Win7/10/11 and actual login/Seewo foreground remain separate evidence; headless launch is not a real desktop/logon acceptance test.
